Lila.facing: Facing[right] means she faces toward the image right. Facing[left] means image left.

notes.HipLeft: The other hip, the supporting leg in Lila v10.
notes.HipRight: The hip that roots the kick in Lila v10, the near (front) leg in the facing-right kick frames. Track the same hip across the pair: a kick that changes hip mid-action with no declared transfer is a continuity break.
notes.armbands: ADOPTED 2026-10-26 (user-confirmed): two thin black buckled bands on HER LEFT upper arm, above the long black arm warmer. In a front view that arm is the VIEWER'S RIGHT. Visibility depends on perspective and facing: in a back view the same arm reads viewer's left, and in side views it may be the far arm or occluded. Absence in a frame where her left arm is not the visible/near arm is not, by itself, a missing-marker failure.
notes.traps: Bare pale legs through the cheongsam side slits are not dark legwear. Bangs cover the viewer's-right eye (her left eye); glasses sit on the viewer's-left eye (her right eye).

notes.RightLeg: The leg that chambers in frame 9 of generated-v2. Track it across the pair.

SadPocky.facing: Facing[right] means she faces toward the image right. Facing[left] means image left.
SadPocky.hard_case: Separate the black thigh strap from the navy skirt by position and shape, not by colour threshold alone. If the strap cannot be seen at this resolution, report marker_seen=false for that leg instead of guessing which leg carries it.

marker_notes.LeftLeg.decal: Carrot decal plus a small bunny decal on HER left upper thigh, with a pink band-aid on the knee and a white sock.
marker_notes.RightLeg.strap: Black thigh strap with a heart ring, on HER right thigh. It is a separate band on the thigh, not the navy pleated skirt. The skirt hangs from the waist; the strap sits on the leg itself. Do not merge strap and skirt by colour: both are dark, and naive colour thresholding cannot separate them.

depth: depth_rank 0 is the near (front) leg, 1 is the far (back) leg. The kicking leg in the bench cases is the near leg, drawn in front, in all kick frames.
reading_rule: Entity names Right/Left are the character's own right/left, never image left/right. Facing[left/right] is CANDIDATE viewer-side: the direction she faces in the image. A mirrored marker is a FAIL, not a cosmetic swap. Never mirror a sided marker to make a frame pass.
